title: ExtractionOutput
description: Normalized schedule extraction payload with target matching and date-only support

title.description: Sanitized event title capped at 100 characters

start.description: Full ISO 8601 string (+05:30). Required when time_unspecified is false

start_date.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) for date-only events where time_unspecified is true

time_unspecified.description: True when only date was given and time was not specified

ambiguous.description: True when extraction has multiple interpretations or boundary ambiguity

target.description: Target event to cancel or reschedule

original_start.description: Optional known original ISO timestamp (+05:30) of target event

source_quote.description: Minimal matching schedule span extracted from the message
